title: cota brevicuspis
intro: Cota brevicuspis, commonly known as Khas or Kasa, is a plant species in the family Asteraceae. It is traditionally used for its medicinal properties, including its health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects, which help to alleviate various health issues. The therapeutic actions of Cota brevicuspis include its ability to lower fever, reduce pain, and act as an expectorant to relieve respiratory issues. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
